headline: Site plan review for 22.5 Overledge Drive Phase V subdivision and a site walk for 63 English Range Rd.
summary: The meeting covers a site plan review for the Phase V subdivision at 22.5 Overledge Drive. It also covers a suggested site walk for the 13 Lot Subdivision at 63 English Range Rd and a workshop on a project charter for acquiring new conservation land.
